title: Peartree's Chest Key
summary: Opens the wall strongbox in the Peartree House basement.

fields.Lock: Wall-mounted Strongbox at (572, 758), downstairs in Peartree House.
fields.Acquisition: A DC 20 Perception check reveals the loose floor planks hiding it.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
